picks.reasoning: Call it stubborn, but Faker, Keria and that T1 core win lanes and carry games by themselves, and I don't care that the GD@15 chart looks bad or that the crowd loves GEN and BLG.
Early game is everything, and KC's +1.1k GD@15 over 38 games is the best sample on the board: they take first objectives and snowball the map before anyone else wakes up.
Fearless rewards the team that never runs out of comfort picks, and BLG's 52 series wins and +1.0k GD@15 say they draft their way out of trouble better than anyone left.
GEN tops every column I trust: a 73.6% game win rate, 40-10 in series and 7-1 against other regions. BLG is close behind, but GEN has the cleaner résumé.
I back T1: they've stayed calm through every tense room at Worlds, and their last two wins were clean 2-0s, so I trust the team to hold together when it gets loud.
